description:
THREE-TONE PAINTING — the palette is the entire brief.
Use only these three colors as the dominant palette, each clearly present in roughly balanced amounts. Tints, shades and blends of these three are fine for light and depth; introduce no other hues.
• Tone 1: #4D58AB — muted blue (RGB 77, 88, 171; closest named color: slate blue)
• Tone 2: #391BAD — ultramarine (RGB 57, 27, 173; closest named color: rebecca purple)
• Tone 3: #ECAE39 — orange (RGB 236, 174, 57; closest named color: goldenrod)
PROMPT (paint this, still using only the three tones): Facing the Music
Let the three tones set the mood, light and composition. No text, letters, labels, color swatches or palette charts anywhere in the image.
